newsitem.title: USA: CME live, feeder cattle slip, in line with beef.
newsitem.headline: CME live, feeder cattle slip, in line with beef.

text.p: CME live and feeder cattle cattle futures dropped in early midsession in line with lower cash beef prices Tuesday and expected weak cash cattle prices Wednesday, encouraging early selling, traders said.
USDA beef cutout values were down $0.12 to $0.64 per cwt Tuesday, which traders said should discourage meat packers from bidding more than $66.00 for cash cattle.
At 1036 CDT, live cattle lost 0.150 to 0.350 cent with June off 0.175, asking at 64.675 cents per lb. Feeder cattle were off 0.050 to 0.400 cent per lb with August off 0.275, asking at 78.600 cents.
